title: Albury, NSW - Infrastructure Restoration
current_summary: An upstream provider has restored services following an unplanned access network issue affecting some internet services in Albury, NSW. Service was restored at 8:51 PM AEST on 29 September 2026. If your connection has not come back online, please restart your modem/router and, if you have one, your connection box, then contact our support team.

updates.content: Earlier today some customers in Albury, NSW experienced a loss of internet due to an issue in the access network. Services were restored at 8:51 PM AEST on 29 September 2026. If you are still offline, please restart your modem/router and, if you have one, your connection box. We are monitoring and here to help.
